Name: Green Rain Overrides
Author: pneuma163
Description:
[size=3]The mod overrides some things on green rain days, per its config. By default it lets you give gifts to NPCs on the green rain day in year 1 and it allows electronics (TV, phone, jukeboxes) to function on any green rain day. Either of these can be turned off in the config. The motivation for the mod is that as players we've seen green rain days before and we might like to have a green rain day that is less interruptive.[/size]

[size=5]How to install:[/size]

[size=3]- Install the latest version of SMAPI [url=https://smapi.io]https://smapi.io[/url]
- Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
- Run the game using SMAPI.

If you need additional help installing the mod, the Stardew Valley wiki [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started[/url] has more detailed instructions.
To uninstall the mod, delete this mod's folder from your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.

Note: the mod can be installed (or removed) at any time.[/size]

[size=5]Configuration[/size]

[size=3]I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to set your configuration options, or you can edit the config.json that generates after you run the game with the mod installed.[/size]

[size=3]GiftsToNPCs: whether the player can give gifts to NPCs during any green rain day (default is true)[/size]
[size=3]ElectronicsWork: whether electronics like the TV, phone, or jukeboxes work/function during any green rain day (default is true)[/size]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

[size=3]This mod uses harmony to edit a few green rain checks in specific parts of the game code by taking the result of those checks and then further modifying them according to the config options for this mod. There should be no conflicts and I have tested it alongside a large set of mods, but feel free to report any problems.[/size]

[size=5]Translations[/size]

[size=3]If you would like to translate the mod, see my profile for general instructions regarding translations.[/size]

[size=5]Remarks[/size]

[size=3]If there is interest, I can add other features that fit the scope of the mod: making green rain days be configurably more like any other day.[/size]

[size=3]The scroll in the mod's main image was created using: https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/[/size]
